Protocol Amendment (a) _ nonsubstantial amendment addressing feedback from an internal safety committee. Changes include updates to Exclusion Criteria (Section 5.2) regarding insulin use restrictions, Section 6.9.1 prohibiting insulin use for ≥14 consecutive days, Section 6.9.2 updating rescue therapy language and adding short_term insulin provisions, and Section 6.9.3 clarifying short_term insulin allowed for urgent use. data.name: Age requirement
data.text: Participant must be at least 18 years of age and of the legal age of consent in the jurisdiction in which the study is taking place at the time of signing the informed consent.

data.name: Type 2 diabetes diagnosis
data.text: Have a clinical diagnosis of T2D according to the World Health Organization (WHO) classification or other locally applicable standards for at least 6 months prior to screening (Visit 1), with HbA1c ≤10.0% (86 mmol/mol) at screening (Visit 1).

data.name: Stable T2D treatment
data.text: Are on stable treatment for T2D for at least 90 days prior to screening (Visit 1), consisting of either diet/exercise alone or up to 3 oral AHMs (excluding incretins). Note: DPP_4i are allowed.

data.name: BMI requirement
data.text: Have a BMI >27 kg/m2 at Visit 1. Note: In participants with limb amputation or limb loss, the investigator should reach out to the Lilly medical monitor for information regarding calculation of BMI.

data.name: Stable body weight
data.text: Have a stable body weight (<5% body weight change) for 90 days prior to screening at Visit 1.

data.name: History of unsuccessful dietary effort
data.text: Have a history of at least 1 self_reported unsuccessful dietary effort to reduce body weight.

data.name: Contraceptive requirements
data.text: IOCBP, INOCBP, and individuals AMAB who agree to abide by the reproductive and contraceptive requirements provided in Section 10.4. may participate in this trial. See Section 10.4 for definitions and additional requirements related to contraception. Note: Contraceptive use by participants should be consistent with local regulations regarding the methods of contraception for those participating in clinical studies. For the contraception requirements of this protocol, see Section 10.4.

data.name: Informed consent capability
data.text: Are capable of giving signed informed consent as described in Appendix 1, which includes compliance with the requirements and restrictions listed in the ICF and in this protocol.

data.name: Reliability and willingness to comply
data.text: Are reliable and willing to make themselves available for the duration of the study and attend required study visits, and are willing and able to follow study procedures as required, such as self_inject study intervention; store and take the provided study intervention as directed; maintain electronic study diary and paper log; complete the required questionnaires; and undergo DXA procedure. Note: if a person is unable to undergo the DXA due to physical limitations of the DXA machine, or because they have implants, hardware, or other foreign materials that may interfere with the scan according to the DXA manufacturer's specification, this will not be considered an exclusionary criterion. See Section 8.1.2 for further details.

data.name: Prior or planned surgical treatment for obesity
data.text: Have a prior or planned surgical treatment for obesity. Exception: The following are allowed if performed >1 year before screening (Visit 1): liposuction; cryolipolysis; or abdominoplasty.

data.name: Prior or planned endoscopic/device_based therapy for obesity
data.text: Have a prior or planned endoscopic procedure and/or device_based therapy for obesity, such as, but not limited to mucosal ablation; gastric artery embolization; laparoscopic adjustable gastric banding; intragastric balloon; or duodenal_jejunal endoluminal liner. Exception: Prior device_based therapy is acceptable if device removal was more than 6 months prior to screening (Visit 1).

data.name: Obesity induced by endocrinologic disorders or monogenetic/syndromic forms
data.text: Have obesity induced by other endocrinologic disorders, for example, Cushing Syndrome, or are diagnosed with monogenetic or syndromic forms of obesity, for example, Melanocortin 4 Receptor deficiency or Prader Willi Syndrome.

data.name: Type 1 diabetes or related conditions
data.text: Have type 1 diabetes mellitus, latent autoimmune diabetes, or history of ketoacidosis or hyperosmolar coma.

data.name: Severe hypoglycemia or hypoglycemia unawareness
data.text: Have had 1 or more episode of severe hypoglycemia and/or 1 or more episode of hypoglycemia unawareness within the 180 days prior to Visit 1. Note: Any participant that the investigator feels will not be able to communicate an understanding of hypoglycemic symptoms and the appropriate treatment of hypoglycemia should also be excluded.

data.name: High fasting glucose
data.text: Have fasting glucose >270 mg/dL (>15.0 mmol/L) confirmed by the central laboratory at screening (Visit 1).

data.name: Recent use of prohibited antihyperglycemic medications
data.text: Have taken within 90 days before screening (Visit 1) any of the following AHMs: amylin analogs; GLP_1 receptor agonists; GIP/GLP receptor agonists; or insulin.

data.name: Current or planned treatment for diabetic retinopathy and/or macular edema
data.text: Are currently receiving or planning to receive treatment for diabetic retinopathy and/or macular edema, for example, laser photocoagulation or intravitreal injections of antivascular endothelial growth factor inhibitors. Note: All participants will have a baseline fundus photography assessment prior to randomization (Visit 3). Qualifying fundus photographs obtained within 90 days before Visit 1 may be used for eligibility determination. See Section 8.2.11.

data.name: Renal impairment
data.text: Have renal impairment measured as eGFR <30 mL/min/1.73 m2, calculated by eGFRcr_cys formula as per Chronic Kidney Disease Epidemiology Collaboration as determined by central laboratory during screening (Visit 1).

data.name: Significant active autoimmune abnormality
data.text: Have evidence of significant, active autoimmune abnormality, for example, lupus or rheumatoid arthritis, that, in the opinion of the investigator, is likely to require concurrent treatment with systemic glucocorticoids during the course of the study.

data.name: Recent cardiovascular events
data.text: Have had within 90 days prior to screening (Visit 1): acute myocardial infarction.

data.text: Liver chemistry stopping criteria (Section 7.1.1) require permanent discontinuation of study intervention; hepatic safety monitoring and evaluation criteria for study drug interruption or discontinuation are described in Section 8.2.9.

data.name: Discontinuation of Study Intervention
data.text: Discontinuation of study intervention per Section 7.1; participants permanently discontinuing study intervention should complete early discontinuation (ED) visit procedures and posttreatment follow_up visit(s).

data.name: Participant Withdrawal from Study
data.text: Participant discontinuation/withdrawal from the study per Section 7.2. If the participant is discontinuing at the time of a scheduled visit, perform that visit as an ED visit.

data.name: Early Discontinuation (ED) Visit
data.description: ED visits will be completed by participants permanently discontinuing early from the study. These participants should also complete posttreatment follow_up visit(s). If the participant is discontinuing at the time of a scheduled visit, that visit is performed as an ED visit.

data.name: Withdrawal Prior to First Dose
data.description: Participants who withdraw from the study after signing the informed consent but who have not taken a dose of study intervention do not need to complete ED procedures.

data.name: Screen Failure
data.description: Participants not meeting eligibility criteria during the up_to_35_day screening period (Visit 1 to Visit 3) exit prior to randomization (e.g., fasting glucose >270 mg/dL, eGFR <30 mL/min/1.73 m2, PHQ_9 ≥15 at Visit 1 or Visit 3).

data.name: Lost to Follow_up
data.description: Participant lost to follow up per Section 7.3.

data.name: Study Completion
data.description: Completion of up to 64 weeks of treatment (12_week dose escalation plus 52_week maintenance) followed by the 6_week posttreatment follow_up period, including the required safety follow_up visit (Visit 801) approximately 6 weeks after the last treatment visit.

data.name: Randomization Eligibility Decision
data.description: At Visit 3 (end of up to 35_day screening), eligibility is confirmed and participants are randomized 2:1:2:2:2 to placebo or eloralintide 1.5, 3, 6, or 9 mg SC QW.

data.name: Dose Escalation Step Decision (every 4 weeks)
data.description: During the 12_week dose escalation period, dose is stepped up every 4 weeks toward the assigned final dose, subject to tolerability and dose modification criteria.

data.name: Glycemic Rescue Decision
data.description: At treatment visits (every 4 to 12 weeks), investigator assesses severe, persistent hyperglycemia and may initiate short_term insulin rescue therapy in a hospital or closely monitored setting; insulin use for ≥14 consecutive days is prohibited.

data.name: Hepatic Safety Interruption/Discontinuation Decision
data.description: Hepatic safety monitoring at scheduled and unscheduled visits determines temporary interruption or permanent discontinuation of study intervention.

data.name: End of Treatment Transition Decision
data.description: At completion of the maximum 64_week treatment duration, participants transition to the 6_week posttreatment follow_up period and Visit 801.
